caption: The drawing depicts a single jug with a wide body, a narrow neck, a flared lip, and a large curved handle on the right side. The jug is colored in shades of brown, orange, and yellow, with vertical streaks of green and blue running down its body. The blue and green tones appear mainly around the upper and central portions, contrasting with the dominant warm hues. The mouth of the jug has a wavy edge, and the lower portion of the jug rests on a base that curves outward. The background is plain and uncolored, which makes the jug the central focus of the drawing. The artist’s signature is present near the bottom right, and there are small inscriptions in the lower left and upper right corners.
title: Bennington Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
